parameters.query:
=SELECT true AS ok,
COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'severity',severity,'error_code',error_code,'error_message',error_message,'recoverable',recoverable,'created_at',created_at,'resolved_at',resolved_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) AS errors
FROM content_errors
WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid;
